variables.name: RESULTS_CLIP_LABEL
variables.comment: Label used to denote the clip data type used for remote input transport

variables.name: EXTRA_RESULTS_DATA
variables.comment: Extra added to a clip data intent object to hold the text results bundle.

variables.name: EXTRA_DATA_TYPE_RESULTS_DATA
variables.comment: Extra added to a clip data intent object to hold the data results bundle.

variables.name: EXTRA_RESULTS_SOURCE
variables.comment: Extra added to a clip data intent object identifying the {@link Source} of the results.

variables.name: SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT
variables.comment: The user manually entered the data.

variables.name: SOURCE_CHOICE
variables.comment: The user selected one of the choices from {@link #getChoices}.

variables.name: EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_AUTO
variables.comment: The platform will determine whether choices will be edited before being sent to the app.

variables.name: EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_DISABLED
variables.comment: Tapping on a choice should send the input immediately, without letting the user edit it.

variables.name: EDIT_CHOICES_BEFORE_SENDING_ENABLED
variables.comment: Tapping on a choice should let the user edit the input before it is sent to the app.

methods.name: public String getResultKey()
methods.comment:
* Get the key that the result of this input will be set in from the Bundle returned by
     * {@link #getResultsFromIntent} when the {@link android.app.PendingIntent} is sent.

methods.name: public CharSequence getLabel()
methods.comment: * Get the label to display to users when collecting this input.

methods.name: public CharSequence @Nullable [] getChoices()
methods.comment: * Get possible input choices. This can be {@code null} if there are no choices to present.

methods.name: public boolean isDataOnly()
public boolean getAllowFreeFormInput()
methods.comment:
* Get whether or not users can provide an arbitrary value for
     * input. If you set this to {@code false}, users must select one of the
     * choices in {@link #getChoices}. An {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown
     * if you set this to false and {@link #getChoices} returns {@code null} or empty.

methods.name: public int getEditChoicesBeforeSending()
methods.comment:
* Gets whether tapping on a choice should let the user edit the input before it is sent to the
     * app.

methods.name: public Bundle getExtras()
methods.comment: * Get additional metadata carried around with this remote input.

methods.name: public static Map<String, Uri> getDataResultsFromIntent(@NonNull Intent intent, @NonNull String remoteInputResultKey)
public static Bundle getResultsFromIntent(@NonNull Intent intent)
public static void addResultsToIntent(RemoteInput @NonNull [] remoteInputs, @NonNull Intent intent, @NonNull Bundle results)
methods.comment:
* Populate an intent object with the results gathered from remote input. This method
     * should only be called by remote input collection services when sending results to a
     * pending intent.
     * @param remoteInputs The remote inputs for which results are being provided
     * @param intent The intent to add remote inputs to. The {@link android.content.ClipData}
     *               field of the intent will be modified to contain the results.
     * @param results A bundle holding the remote input results. This bundle should
     *                be populated with keys matching the result keys specified in
     *                {@code remoteInputs} with values being the result per key.

methods.name: public static void addDataResultToIntent(@NonNull RemoteInput remoteInput, @NonNull Intent intent, @NonNull Map<String, Uri> results)
methods.comment:
* Same as {@link #addResultsToIntent} but for setting data results.
     * @param remoteInput The remote input for which results are being provided
     * @param intent The intent to add remote input results to. The
     *               {@link ClipData} field of the intent will be
     *               modified to contain the results.
     * @param results A map of mime type to the Uri result for that mime type.

methods.name: public static void setResultsSource(@NonNull Intent intent, @Source int source)
methods.comment:
* Set the source of the RemoteInput results. This method should only be called by remote
     * input collection services (e.g.
     * {@link android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService})
     * when sending results to a pending intent.
     *
     * @see #SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT
     * @see #SOURCE_CHOICE
     *
     * @param intent The intent to add remote input source to. The {@link ClipData}
     *               field of the intent will be modified to contain the source.
     * @param source The source of the results.

methods.name: public static int getResultsSource(@NonNull Intent intent)
methods.comment:
* Get the source of the RemoteInput results.
     *
     * @see #SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT
     * @see #SOURCE_CHOICE
     *
     * @param intent The intent object that fired in response to an action or content intent
     *               which also had one or more remote input requested.
     * @return The source of the results. If no source was set, {@link #SOURCE_FREE_FORM_INPUT} will
     * be returned.
